subject: Coffee prices are about to spike — here's why
preheader: Frost in Brazil, a weak harvest, and what it means for your morning cup.
headline: Why your coffee is about to get more expensive

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body: A run of poor harvests in Brazil and Vietnam, the two largest coffee producers, has tightened global supply just as demand keeps climbing. Futures prices have nearly doubled in a year.

sections.heading: Prices by quarter
sections.body: Arabica futures have climbed steadily each quarter since early 2025, with the sharpest jump following a frost warning in Brazil's Minas Gerais region.
